scope: SchemaRouter operation routing long-term production quality targets
rationale: The current 0.10 graph-projection research cycle retains its preregistered development gates for methodological integrity. These targets define the long-term OSS/production objective for subsequent research cycles and must not retroactively change current-cycle promotion criteria.

supported_exact_route_accuracy.metric: Exact tool.endpoint match on supported requests

false_route_rate.metric: Unsupported or otherwise no-route requests incorrectly routed to an executable tool.endpoint

supporting_requirements: OOD rejection should remain effectively perfect on the maintained blind/stress suites.
Mean latency should improve or remain operationally competitive versus the paired full-BGE baseline.
p95 latency must not regress against the paired production baseline for a promoted candidate.
Report language-level and operation-level worst-case slices; aggregate accuracy alone is insufficient.
Prefer safe abstention to a false executable route.
Never broaden tool, endpoint, field, argument, credential, or side-effect authority from semantic evidence.

milestone_sequence.label: current research gate
milestone_sequence.note: Frozen for the current preregistered 0.10 graph-projection cycle only.
